reviews.title: Check which side your button's on?
reviews.comment: It's a DVD drive. Worked perfectly. I was able to read DVDs replace the one that was broken. I didn't realize that the open and close button is on different sides for different DVD drives. So the facade that fits over the computer didn't work right but I could still access the button just fine.
